exposure: exclusive breastfeeding in the first 4 months of life
maternal depressive symptoms during the pre- and postnatal periods
cohort: 20,803 elementary-school children (mean age 9.19 years) in China
finding: School-aged children who were not exclusively breastfed for the first 4 months of life, born post-term, delivered by cesarean section, or born to mothers with pre- and postnatal depressive symptoms had a higher likelihood of allergic rhinitis.
mod_finding: Children delivered by cesarean section had a higher likelihood of allergic rhinitis (OR: 1.07; 95% CI: 1.00-1.19).
